title: Physics diagnostics without training: does the phase error depend on neighbour power?
git_commit: recorded in logs (git log -1 at run time)
split_source: experiments/E004_training_file_curve/config.json: train_pool_files[:30] (alpha fit), validation 45 (decisions), test 45 (report), as E007-E014
signal: received symbols after phase recovery as stored in the CSV (rx_I, rx_Q), one sample per symbol, one polarization; 16-QAM levels +-1/sqrt(10), +-3/sqrt(10): rings |a| = 0.447, 1.000, 1.342
symbols: centre symbols of window 31 (15 trimmed at each file edge), the same symbols as the BER metric of E010-E014
fit: minimize mean |z_k exp(-i sum_j alpha_j |z_{k+j}|^2) - a_k|^2 over alpha (scipy.optimize L-BFGS-B, torch float64 gradient), alpha = 0 start, train files only
bootstrap: resampling whole files with replacement (seed 20261023); no training seeds exist in E015
control: no network is trained, so the complex_a control does not apply; instead the raw test BER must equal 0.009551859551859552 (experiments/E004_training_file_curve/config.json, test_mean_raw_ber) to 1e-12, otherwise ОШИБКА and the rest is skipped

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
memory_present_if_all: (a) on validation |rho(dphi, P_nb(R))| >= |rho(dphi, |z|^2)| for at least one R in {1, 3, 7, 15} (Spearman, all rings)
(b) on validation the fit with R = 7 reduces BER by at least fit_gap_pp more than the fit with R = 1
(c) on test the sign is the same and |test / validation| is within test_ratio_range, for rho of the R with the largest validation |rho| and for the R7 - R1 gap
rule_draft.uncertainty: 95% file-bootstrap intervals are reported for every number
